meta.status: UNVERIFIED. These picks come from web search results. YouTube is blocked from the build environment, so view counts, channel names, spoken accent and the exact chapters could not be checked. Titles are copied as they appeared in the results. A TA should open each link once before students see it.
meta.selection: One main video (or playlist) per island that overlaps the most with the syllabus items, plus extras for what the main one does not cover. No video found covers a whole island, so each island lists its gaps.

main.title: Algorithms Course - Graph Theory Tutorial from a Google Engineer

why.he: קורס מלא בתורת הגרפים. לפי הזיכרון שלי הוא כולל BFS, DFS, מיון טופולוגי ו-MST, אבל לא אימתי את הפרקים. בדקו את רשימת הפרקים בתיאור.
why.en: A full graph theory course. From memory it includes BFS, DFS, topological sort and MST, but I could not verify the chapters. Check the chapter list in the description.

gaps.he: ייצוג גרף כנושא נפרד אינו מובטח בקורס.
